name: Rage Trip
summary:
Rage Trip is a 2D pixel art precision platformer featuring six levels filled with spikes, saws, flames, and moving platforms. Players navigate obstacles, collect cherries, and reach the finish while prerecorded voice taunts react to their failures and level completions.

The game includes a solo campaign and two multiplayer modes for 2–4 players. In Friend Race, players compete to finish first, with individual deaths and respawns. In Shared Fate, one teammate’s death sends the entire team back to the start of the level. Players also collide with one another, adding another challenge to coordinating their jumps.
